operations.comment: ; Round 02 current-source commentary. Offsets in notes include the 16-byte iNES header.
; Mapper 2: lower CPU $8000..$BFFF is a switchable 16 KiB window.
; Classified action code uses physical 8 KiB banks 18/19; menu/title uses 24/25.
; CPU $C000..$FFFF is fixed in physical banks 30/31. Mapper selector is not an 8 KiB bank index.
; Binary includes preserve classified opaque data and unknown spans exactly; they are not decoding claims.
; scratch00..scratch1f and scratch47..scratch5c have routine-local lifetimes; names do not imply shared semantics.
; fighter_* indexed arrays use 0/1 unless a word array explicitly multiplies the index by two.
; Actor record: X word +0/+1, Y +2, pose word +3/+4, facing +5, metadata +6..+9, box count +10.
; Collision records start at +11, six bytes each; see test_attack_defense_boxes.
; 35-byte fighter configuration: stats +0..+5, ten-byte name +6..+15; money word sequence +18..+21.
; Configuration fields and mechanical action formats are documented below; most action IDs retain unresolved game meanings.
; CPU RAM, PPU/APU registers, and view-specific ROM table addresses.
; Shared training fields reuse bout/referee RAM: names reflect these routines only.
; training_timer and training_history_or_set_ids have distinct per-screen lifetimes.
; All addresses in physical notes include the 16-byte iNES header. Static code need not be naturally reached.
; Screen-local aliases keep reused addresses distinct in the readable source.
